fixed.summary: An impostor's card outline is cooked from the same ray-march rules the shader draws by (stated once in og-render-data and written into the shader), and those rules are part of the cooked model's stamp: a change to them cooks every impostor's outline again, so a card can no longer be trimmed by an older rule than the one it is drawn by. Impostors cooked before this version are cooked again once.
